blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reading behaviour varies not only with linguistic input, but also with reader proficiency. In this study, we investigate whether the layer-wise relationship between surprisal from large language models (LLMs) and human gaze behaviour differs across readers with different levels of proficiency and across gaze measures.
Using eye-tracking data from the MECO L2 corpus, we compare readers with high and low vocabulary proficiency on first-pass gaze duration (FPGD) and total gaze duration (TGD). We quantify the distribution of the predictive power of surprisal across model layers using Predictive Depth.
Across 12 tested LLMs, we find that readers with lower vocabulary proficiency tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD, while this difference is smaller for TGD. Also, TGD itself shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both proficiency groups. These patterns suggest that where predictive power is concentrated across LLM layers may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures, and that this relationship can vary with reader proficiency.
Our leave-one-out analysis further shows that the advantage of informative internal layers extends to unseen texts, although the practical improvements in prediction are limited. Overall, our results show that layer-wise LLM surprisal provides a useful perspective on variation in reading behaviour across both reader groups and gaze measures. 1 1 1 Code will be available at https://github.com/ahaya3776/proficiency_surprisal .
blocks.zh:
阅读行为不仅在语言输入上不同,在阅读能力上也不同. 在这项研究中,我们调查大语言模型(LLMs)的顶端与人类的目光行为之间的分层关系,是否因不同水平的熟练程度和不同目光尺度的读者而有所不同.
利用来自MECO L2体的眼跟踪数据,我们比较了阅读器在第一通道视距(FPGD)和总视距(TGD)上的高和低词汇熟练度. 我们用预测深度来量化超导在模型层之间的预测力分布.
在经过测试的12个LLMs中,我们发现词汇熟练度较低的读者往往表现出FPGD更深的预测深度,而TGD的这种差异较小. 此外,技术GD本身显示,在两个熟练组中,预测深度比FPGD更深。 这些模式表明,在预测力集中在LLM层上的地方,可能与不同凝视度量所捕获的读取过程的时间和广度有关,而这种关系会随着读者的熟练程度而变化.
我们的 " 一放一出 " 分析进一步表明,内部资料层的优点扩大到无形文本,尽管预测的实际改进有限。 总体来看,我们的结果显示,分层的 LLM 超热量为读者群体和视线测量在阅读行为上的差异提供了有益的视角。 1 1 《守则》可在https://github.com/ahaya3776/proficiency_surprisal查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
While text difficulty is often treated as a fixed property of the text, understanding the reading process requires considering the interaction between readers and linguistic structures. This perspective is particularly important in fields such as text simplification, which aims to enhance reader comprehension by rewriting complex texts into more accessible forms ( Siddharthan, 2014 ; Alva-Manchego et al., 2020 ) .
However, traditional methods for evaluating text difficulty often rely on surface-level metrics, such as Flesch-Kincaid Grading Levels ( Kincaid et al., 1975 ) , or comprehension accuracy ( Agrawal and Carpuat, 2024 ) . While these measures can indicate if a text is linguistically simple or if a reader eventually understands it, they provide limited information about how the text is processed during reading. This is of paramount importance because readers with different levels of proficiency may process the same text differently.
blocks.zh:
虽然文本难度常被作为文本的固定属性对待,但理解阅读过程需要考虑读者与语言结构之间的相互作用. 这种观点在诸如文本简化等领域特别重要,因为简化的目的是通过将复杂的文本改写成更便于查阅的形式来增强读者的理解(Siddharthan,2014年;Alva-Manchego等人,2020年)。
然而,传统的文字难度评价方法往往依赖于表面水平的度量,如Flesch-Kincaid梯级(Kincaid等人,1975年)或理解准确性(Agrawal和Carpuat,2024年)。 虽然这些措施可以表明一个文本在语言上是否简单,或者读者最终是否理解它,但它们对文本在阅读过程中的处理方式提供的信息有限. 这一点至关重要,因为具有不同水平熟练程度的读者可能不同地处理同一文本。

Readers with limited vocabulary knowledge (red) tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD compared to readers with higher vocabulary knowledge (blue). The difference in Predictive Depth is smaller for TGD, which itself shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both reader groups.

blocks.en:
In this context, surprisal from large language models (LLMs) provides a useful way to examine human reading behaviour. While surprisal has been widely utilized to predict human reading times ( Smith and Levy, 2013 ; Kuribayashi et al., 2022 ; Shain et al., 2024 ) , recent findings suggest that different internal layers of LLMs have different predictive power for human reading times ( Kuribayashi et al., 2025 ) .
Importantly, different reading measures are best predicted by surprisal from different parts of LLMs.
For example, measures which capture relatively fast responses, such as gaze duration, tend to be better predicted by surprisal from shallower layers, whereas measures which capture slower responses show stronger predictive power in deeper layers.
Among eye-tracking measures, first-pass gaze duration (FPGD) and total gaze duration (TGD) capture different spans of reading behaviour. FPGD reflects the initial pass over a word, while TGD includes later and repeated fixations.
This pattern may be related to differences in the timing and breadth of cognitive processing captured by each measure.
blocks.zh:
在这方面,从大语言模型(LLMs)中获取的优势为检查人类的阅读行为提供了一个有用的途径. 虽然悬浮层已被广泛用于预测人类阅读时间(Smith and Levy,2013;Kuribayashi等人,2022;Shain等人,2024),但最近的研究结果表明,不同内部层的LLM对于人类阅读时间具有不同的预测力(Kuribayashi等人,2025).
重要的是,对不同阅读尺度的最佳预测是来自法学硕士课程不同部分的追加。
例如,从较浅的地层获取相对快速反应的措施,如视距,往往通过超低层得到更好的预测,而从较浅的地层获取较慢反应的措施显示,在更深的地层中,预测力更强。
在眼睛跟踪措施中,首先通过视距(FPGD)和总视距(TGD)可捕捉不同范围的阅读行为。 FPGD反映了一个单词的初始通过,而TGD包括后来和重复的固定.
这种模式可能与每项措施所捕获的认知处理的时间和广度的不同有关。

blocks.en: While previous studies have mainly focused on native English speakers, the potential of this approach becomes evident when considering the diversity of reader proficiency. Cognitive models of reading suggest that less-proficient readers may engage in compensatory processing ( Stanovich, 1980 ) when faced with linguistic obstacles, such as difficult vocabulary or syntax. In such cases, they may rely more on contextual information to support comprehension. This raises the possibility that reader proficiency may also be an important factor in determining which internal layers best explain reading behaviour.
blocks.zh: 虽然以往的研究主要侧重于讲英语的本地人,但考虑到读者熟练程度的多样性,这种做法的潜力就很明显了。 认知的阅读模式表明,不熟练的读者在面临语言障碍,如词汇或语法困难时,可能从事补偿性处理(Stanovich,1980年). 在这种情况下,他们可能更多地依赖背景信息来支持理解。 这提出了读者熟练程度也可能是决定哪个内部层最能解释阅读行为的重要因素的可能性.

blocks.en: In this study, we examine how the layer-wise relationship between LLM surprisal and reading behaviour varies with reader proficiency and gaze measure, focusing on FPGD and TGD. To summarise the layer-wise distribution of predictive power, we introduce Predictive Depth, which measures how the predictive power of surprisal is distributed across LLM layers.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们研究了LLM超常行为和阅读行为之间的分层关系如何随着读者的熟练程度和视线度而有所不同,重点是FPGD和TGD. 为了总结预测力的分层分布,我们引入了预测深度(Presidentive Depth),该深度测量了超导的预测力如何在LLM层之间分布.

blocks.en: We find that the layer-wise relationship between LLM surprisal and reading behaviour varies both with reader proficiency and gaze measure. For FPGD, readers with lower vocabulary proficiency tend to show deeper Predictive Depth, while this difference is substantially reduced for TGD. Also, TGD generally shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD across both proficiency groups. A leave-one-out analysis further shows that the predictive advantage of selected internal layers extends to unseen texts, although the improvements are small.
blocks.zh: 我们发现 LLM 超音速和阅读行为之间的分层关系 随读者的熟练程度和视线度而有所不同。 对于FPGD来说,词汇熟练度较低的读者往往表现出更深的预测深度,而对于TGD来说这种差异则大大缩小. 此外,总的来看,在两个熟练组中,总的预测深度比FPGD更深。 一项 " 一放一出 " 的分析进一步表明,某些内部层的预测优势延伸到未见文本,尽管改进幅度很小。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We show that the layer depth at which surprisal best predicts reading behaviour varies with vocabulary proficiency. • We show that this relationship also differs between FPGD and TGD, revealing a clear effect of gaze measure. • We show that surprisal provides weak to modest predictive gains on unseen texts, with the selected internal layer generally outperforming the final layer.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们显示,上层最能预测阅读行为的层深因词汇熟练程度而异。 我们显示,这种关系在FPGD和TGD之间也有所不同,揭示了凝视措施的明确效果。 我们显示,在未见文本上,超额可提供微弱到微小的预测收益,选定的内部层一般比最后一层要好。

blocks.en: We show that the layer depth at which surprisal best predicts reading behaviour varies with vocabulary proficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,顶端最能预测阅读行为的层深因词汇熟练程度而异.

blocks.en: We show that this relationship also differs between FPGD and TGD, revealing a clear effect of gaze measure.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,这种关系在FPGD和TGD之间也有所不同,揭示了凝视度量的明显效果.

blocks.en: We show that surprisal provides weak to modest predictive gains on unseen texts, with the selected internal layer generally outperforming the final layer.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,在未见文本上,超额可提供微弱到微小的预测收益,选定的内部层一般比最后一层要好。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Cognitive Models of Reading
blocks.zh: 2.1 认知阅读模式

blocks.en:
Reading involves the coordination of lower-level lexical access with higher-level semantic integration ( Kintsch, 1988 ) . A fundamental distinction between proficient and less-proficient readers lies in the automaticity of these processes. Proficient readers can access lexical information with relatively little conscious effort ( LaBerge and Samuels, 1974 ) . This automaticity leaves more cognitive resources available for higher-level semantic integration ( Perfetti and Hart, 2002 ) . In contrast, when lexical access is less automatic, readers may rely more on contextual information to support word recognition and comprehension ( Stanovich, 1980 ) .
While contextual information can support comprehension, greater reliance on context may also require readers to integrate information across a broader context ( Harrington and Sawyer, 1992 ; Carretti et al., 2009 ) .
Therefore, differences in proficiency can affect not only whether a text is understood, but also how linguistic information is processed during reading.
blocks.zh:
阅读涉及协调较低层次的语法访问与更高层次的语义集成(Kintsch,1988年)。 熟练和不熟练的读者的根本区别在于这些过程的自动性. 熟练的读者能够以相对较少的自觉努力获取词汇信息(LaBerge and Samuels,1974.). 这种自动性为更高层次的语义集成留下了更多的认知资源(Perfetti and Hart, 2002.). 相比之下,当词汇访问的自动性较低时,读者可能更多地依赖背景信息来支持单词识别和理解(Stanovich,1980年).
虽然背景信息可以支持理解,但更多地依赖背景也可能需要读者在更广泛的背景下整合信息(Harrington和Sawyer,1992年;Carreti等人,2009年)。
因此,熟练程度的差异不仅会影响文本是否被理解,也会影响语言信息在阅读过程中的处理.

blocks.en: These differences are also reflected in eye-movement behaviour. Measures such as FPGD and TGD provide observable traces of the underlying cognitive processes involved in reading ( Rayner, 1998 ) . Examining variation in these measures can help us investigate how processes such as lexical access and semantic integration differ across readers with different levels of proficiency.
blocks.zh: 这些差异也反映在眼动行为上. 诸如FPGD和TGD等措施提供了阅读所涉基本认知过程的可见痕迹(Rayner,1998年)。 审视这些措施中的差异,可以帮助我们调查不同熟练程度的读者在语言访问和语义融合等过程上的差异.

blocks.en: 2.2 Layer-wise Surprisal and Reading Measures
blocks.zh: 2.2 上层和阅读措施

blocks.en: In computational linguistics, surprisal is defined as the negative log-probability of a word given its preceding context ( Hale, 2001 ; Levy, 2008 ) . Surprisal from language models has long been used to model human reading behaviour ( Smith and Levy, 2013 ; Kuribayashi et al., 2022 ; Shain et al., 2024 ) . In recent cognitive modeling frameworks, the unique predictive power of surprisal is typically quantified by the increase in log-likelihood ( Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL ) when surprisal is added to a regression model containing baseline linguistic features ( Oh et al., 2022 ) . More recently, studies have shown that surprisal from the final layer of modern large language models (LLMs) does not always provide the best explanation for human reading times ( Oh and Schuler, 2023 ) , and that surprisal from internal layers can improve predictive performance ( Kuribayashi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在计算语言学中,由于一个单词之前的上下文(Hale,2001年;Levy,2008年),将超音速定义为该词的负对数概率. 语言模型中的surprisal长期用于模拟人类阅读行为(Smith and Levy,2013;Kuribayashi等人,2022;Shain等人,2024). 在最近的认知模型框架里,在包含基线语言特征的回归模型(Oh et al., 2022)中加入超导时,通常会通过log-livality(QQ L \Delta LL)的增加来量化超导的独特预测力. 最近有研究表明,现代大语言模型(LLMs)最后一层的超音速(Oh and Schuler, 2023)并不总是对人类阅读时间提供最好的解释(Oh and Schuler, 2023),而内层的超音速能改善预测性能(Kuribayashi等人, 2025).

blocks.en:
This has motivated closer examination of how predictive power varies across layer depth. Kuribayashi et al. (2025) examined several behavioural measures, including gaze durations, self-paced reading times, N400 responses, and MAZE processing times. They found that relatively fast measures such as gaze duration were better predicted by surprisal from shallower layers, whereas slower measures such as N400 and MAZE showed stronger predictive power in deeper layers. This suggests that the depth at which LLM surprisal is most predictive may vary with the temporal or processing scope of the human measure.
Related probing studies have also shown that deeper layer representations tend to encode more contextualized information ( Peters et al., 2018 ; Vulić et al., 2020 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . These findings are consistent with the view that layer depth may reflect differences in the amount or scope of contextual information encoded across layers.
blocks.zh:
这促使人们更仔细地审查预测力量在层深之间如何变化。 Kuribayashi等人(2025年)研究了几项行为措施,包括视距、自定速度的阅读时间、N400反应和MAZE处理时间。 他们发现,从较浅的地层对视线持续时间等相对较快的尺度进行更好的预测,而N400和MAZE等较慢的尺度在更深的地层显示出更强的预测力. 这表明LLM的超导深度可能随人类测量的时间或处理范围而变化.
相关探险研究也表明,更深层的表达方式倾向于编码更多背景信息(Peters等人,2018年;Vulić等人,2020年;Jin等人,2025年)。 这些结论符合以下观点,即层深可能反映不同层编码的上下文信息的数量或范围的差异.

blocks.en: Recent studies further suggest that this relationship depends on the type of processing being examined. Kuribayashi et al. (2026) found that shallower layers better capture naturalistic reading, whereas deeper layers better capture processing difficulty in syntactically challenging constructions. Tsipidi et al. (2026) similarly found that the strongest predictors vary across eye-tracking measures, with representations from shallower layers performing particularly well for fast response measures and different patterns occurring for slower measures. These findings motivate examining how the predictive power of surprisal changes across layer depth and across gaze measures.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究进一步表明,这种关系取决于所审查的处理类型。 Kuribayashi等人(2026年)发现,较浅的地层更好地捕捉自然主义读物,而更深的地层则更好地捕捉在合成挑战性构造中的加工难度. Tsipidi等人(2026年)同样发现,最强的预测器在眼跟踪措施方面各不相同,较浅层的表示器在快速反应措施方面表现特别良好,在慢度措施方面出现不同的模式。 这些调查结果促使人们审查超额额资金的预测力如何在层深和视线尺度之间发生改变。

blocks.en: 2.3 Research Questions
blocks.zh: 2.3 研究问题

blocks.en: The literature reviewed above suggests two relevant sources of variation in reading behaviour. First, readers with different levels of proficiency may differ in their reliance on lexical and contextual information during reading. Second, the predictive power of LLM surprisal varies across layer depth and across measures that capture different aspects of the reading process. We therefore examine whether the layer-wise distribution of predictive power varies across reader proficiency and across gaze measures. We address this question through the following research questions: • RQ1 : Does reader proficiency affect the distribution of predictive power of LLM surprisal across layer depth? • RQ2 : Does this distribution differ between first-pass gaze duration and total gaze duration?
blocks.zh: 上文审查的文献表明,阅读行为有两种相关的差异。 首先,熟练程度不同的读者在阅读过程中对词汇和背景信息的依赖可能有所不同. 第二,LLM的预测力在层深和捕捉读取过程不同方面的测量上各不相同. 因此,我们审查预测力量的分层分布在读者的熟练程度和视线尺度上是否有所不同。 • RQ1: 读者熟练程度是否影响LLM超层深度的预测力分布? • RQ2:第一次通过视距与总视距之间的分布是否不同?

blocks.en: RQ1 : Does reader proficiency affect the distribution of predictive power of LLM surprisal across layer depth?
blocks.zh: RQ1 :读者熟练程度是否影响LLM悬浮层深度的预测力分布?.

blocks.en: RQ2 : Does this distribution differ between first-pass gaze duration and total gaze duration?
blocks.zh: RQ2 : 这种分布在第一通道视距与总视距之间是否有所不同?

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We investigate the relationship between human gaze patterns and LLM internal representations through a layer-wise surprisal framework. We focus on non-native English readers for the experiment.
blocks.zh: 我们通过层层覆盖框架,调查人类的视线模式与LLM内部代表之间的关系。 我们把注意力集中在非本土英语的读者上,用于实验.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We utilize the MECO L2 dataset (Waves 1 and 2) ( Kuperman et al., 2023 ; Kuperman et al., 2025 ) , which provides eye-tracking data from L2 English speakers with 21 different native language backgrounds who read the same English texts. The participants read 12 encyclopedic texts, ranging from 100 to 200 words in length, and answered comprehension questions after each text.
blocks.zh: 我们利用了MECO L2数据集(Waves 1和2)(Kuperman等人,2023年;Kuperman等人,2025年),该数据集提供了读取相同英文文本的具有21种不同母语背景的L2英语语言的目视跟踪数据。 与会者阅读了12个百科全书文本,长度从100到200字不等,并回答了每个文本之后的理解问题。

blocks.en: Our analysis uses two word-level gaze measures, FPGD and TGD. FPGD is defined as the total fixation time on a word during the first pass before eyes move away from that word, capturing relatively early processing during reading. TGD is defined as the total fixation time on a word, including all subsequent fixations, capturing gaze behaviour over a broader processing span. FPGD and TGD are computed over the same eye-tracking observations 2 2 2 We exclude the first word of each sentence to avoid initial processing noise. . Both measures are log-transformed prior to statistical analysis, and log-FPGD and log-TGD are used as dependent variables in our main analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析采用了两个字级的目视措施,即FPGD和TGD。 FPGD的定义是,在第一次通过时,眼睛离开这个词之前,对一个字的总固定时间,在阅读时捕捉到相对早期的处理. TGD被定义为一个单词上的总固定时间,包括后来的所有固定时间,在更广泛的处理过程中捕捉到凝视行为. FPGD和TGD在同一眼跟踪观测数据中计算。 这两项措施都是在统计分析前转换日志的,在我们的主要分析中,日志-FPGD和日志-TGD被用作依赖变量。

blocks.en: 3.2 Reader Profiling
blocks.zh: 3.2 阅读器剖析

blocks.en: To investigate the impact of vocabulary proficiency, we use LexTALE scores ( Lemhöfer and Broersma, 2012 ) , which are included in the MECO L2 metadata. LexTALE is a lexical decision task in which participants identify whether a given string is a real word or not, providing an efficient estimate of vocabulary size. Based on these scores, we categorize readers into quartiles and focus our analysis on the top (High-Lex) and bottom (Low-Lex) groups.
blocks.zh: 为了调查词汇熟练程度的影响,我们使用LexTALE分数(Lemhöfer and Broersma,2012年),这些分数被列入MECO L2元数据. LexTALE是一个逻辑决定任务,参与者在其中识别给定的字符串是否是一个真实的单词,为词汇大小提供了有效的估计. 基于这些分数,我们把读者分为四类,并将分析的重点放在顶(High-Lex)和底(Low-Lex)组.

blocks.en: 3.3 LLMs and Layer-wise Surprisal Calculation
blocks.zh: 3.3 LLMs和按层计算

blocks.en: We utilize the internal representations of several LLMs, including Gemma 3 (4B, 12B, 27B) ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , Qwen 2.5 (7B, 14B, 32B, 72B) ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , OLMo 2 (7B, 13B, 32B) ( OLMo Team, 2025 ) , and Llama 3.1 (8B, 70B) ( Llama Team, 2024 ) . We use base models instead of instruction-tuned models.
blocks.zh: 我们利用包括Gemma 3(4B、12B、27B)在内的若干法学硕士的内部代表。 (Gemma Team,2025年),Qwen 2.5(7B,14B,32B,72B)(Quen Team,2025年),OLMo 2(7B,13B,32B)(OLMo Team,2025年),Llama 3.1(8B,70B) (拉玛队,2024年). 我们使用基本模型,而不是指导调整模型。

blocks.en: Building on Kuribayashi et al. (2025) , we apply the Logit-Lens technique 3 3 3 https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/interpreting-gpt-the-logit-lens , visited on August 30, 2026. to extract layer-wise information. This method applies the LLM’s final output head directly to the hidden states at each layer. This allows us to derive a probability distribution for each word and calculate its surprisal at every layer, rather than only at the final layer. We calculate these values by providing the full context of each text to the LLMs. For words split into multiple subwords, individual surprisal values are summed to represent the surprisal of the entire word.
blocks.zh: 在Kuribayashi等人(2025年)的基础上,我们采用了Logit-Lens技术3 3 https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/interpretting-gpt-the-logit-lens,于2026年8月30日访问,以提取分层信息。 这种方法将 LLM 的最终输出头直接应用到每个层的隐藏状态. 这使得我们可以得出每个词的概率分布,并计算每个层次的它的顶部,而不只是最后一层. 我们通过向LLMs提供每个文本的全部上下文来计算这些值. 对于拆分成多个子词的词,单个辅词值被概括为代表整个词的辅词.

blocks.en: Through this process, we obtain a surprisal value for every word at every layer of each LLM. These values serve as the basis for evaluating layer-wise predictive power in the following analysis.
blocks.zh: 通过这个过程,我们获得了每个LLM的每层每个字的附加值. 这些数值是下列分析中评价层的预测力的基础。

blocks.en: 3.4 Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 统计分析

blocks.en: 3.4.1 LMM Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 LMM 分析

blocks.en:
We use linear mixed-effects models (LMMs) ( Baayen et al., 2008 ) , a type of regression model, to quantify the layer-wise relationship between LLM surprisal and gaze duration while accounting for repeated observations from participants and reading trials. Here, the dependent variable is log-FPGD or log-TGD, and the explanatory variables include word length, word frequency, and surprisal from LLM layers.
We conduct the layer-wise analyses separately for the High-Lex and Low-Lex reader groups.
blocks.zh:
我们使用线性混合效应模型(LMMs)(Baayen等人,2008年),这是一种回归模型,用于量化LLM超常和视距的分层关系,同时考虑参与者的反复观察和阅读试验. 这里,所依赖的变量是log-FPGD或log-TGD,解释性变量包括词长,词频,以及LLM层的叠加.
我们分别对高脂层和低脂层读者群进行分层分析。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Layer-wise Predictive Profiles
blocks.zh: 4.1 分层预测简介

blocks.en: Before comparing Predictive Depth across reader groups and gaze measures, we first examine the layer-wise predictive power of surprisal. As a result, surprisal from internal layers generally provides better explanations for gaze durations than surprisal from the final output layer, especially for log-FPGD, while the predictive power is not uniformly distributed across layers.
blocks.zh: 比较前 我们首先研究了超前的预测力。 因此,内部层的外延通常比最终输出层的外延更能解释视距,尤其是日志-FPGD的外延,而预测力并不是在层间统一分布.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows representative Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL curves from each tested LLM family for both FPGD and TGD, while the full set of plots can be found in Appendix A .
Gemma 3 4B and OLMo 2 13B exhibit multiple peaks across layers, while Qwen 2.5 72B and Llama 3.1 70B show stronger predictive power towards deeper layers. The detailed profiles also differ between FPGD and TGD, with some LLMs showing stronger predictive power near the final layers for TGD. Despite these broad tendencies, the detailed profiles vary across LLMs and gaze measures, indicating that gaze-predictive surprisal is distributed differently across LLM architectures.

blocks.en: 4.2 Impact of Vocabulary Proficiency
blocks.zh: 4.2 词汇熟练程度的影响

blocks.en: Vocabulary proficiency is systematically associated with the Predictive Depth of surprisal for FPGD. As summarized in Table 2 , P ​ D Low PD_{\mathrm{Low}} is deeper than P ​ D High PD_{\mathrm{High}} for 10 out of 12 tested models for FPGD, with a mean difference of +0.024. Although the magnitude of the difference varies across LLMs, the overall pattern is observed across multiple LLM families. As illustrated in Figure 2 (top), Low-Lex readers often show relatively stronger predictive power in deeper layers, shifting Predictive Depth towards greater depths.
blocks.zh: 词汇熟练程度与FPGD的附加品预测深度有系统关联. 如表2所示,PD Low PD + mathrm{Low}比PD High PD + mathrm{High}更深,对于FPGD的12个测试模型中,有10个,平均差为+ 0.024. 虽然不同法学硕士课程的差异程度不同,但整个模式在多个法学硕士课程家庭都观察到。 如图2(顶部)所示,低脂读物往往在更深层中显示相对更强的预测力,使预测深度向更深层转移.

blocks.en: This difference between proficiency groups is substantially weaker for TGD. P ​ D Low PD_{\mathrm{Low}} is deeper than P ​ D High PD_{\mathrm{High}} in only 4 out of 12 LLMs, and the mean difference is +0.003. Therefore, while readers with less vocabulary tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD, the corresponding difference is small for TGD.
blocks.zh: 对总技术开发部来说,熟练组之间的这种差别要小得多。 PD Low PD + mathrm{Low}比PD High PD → mathrm{ High}在12个LLMs中只有4个,平均差值为+0.03. 因此,虽然词汇较少的读者倾向于对FPGD表现出更深的预测深度,但对TGD来说相应的差异很小.

blocks.en: 4.3 FPGD vs TGD
blocks.zh: 4.3 FPGD对 TGD

blocks.en: We also compare the Predictive Depth between FPGD and TGD within each reader group. As summarized in Table 2 , TGD has a deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD for all 12 LLMs in High-Lex, with a mean difference of +0.050. The same tendency is observed in Low-Lex, where TGD has a deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD for 10 out of 12 LLMs, with a mean difference of +0.030. Therefore, the shift towards deeper layers is observed in both groups, but its magnitude is larger in High-Lex, consistent with the smaller proficiency difference observed in TGD.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了每个读者组中FPGD与TGD之间的预测深度。 如表2所概述,对于所有12种LLM,TGD的预测深度比FPGD更深,平均差额为+0.050。 在Low-Lex中也观察到同样的趋势,在12个LLMs中的10个,TGD的预测深度比FPGD更深,平均差为+0.030. 因此,在两组中都观察到向更深层的转变,但其规模在高层中较大,这与在TGD中观察到的熟练程度差异较小是一致的.

blocks.en: 5 Generalization to Unseen Texts
blocks.zh: 5 通俗化为不明文本

blocks.en: The preceding analyses show that the layer-wise relationship between LLM surprisal and reading behaviour varies with both vocabulary proficiency and gaze measure. An important question is whether these relationships generalize beyond the texts used for LMM fitting. To address this question, we conduct a leave-one-out (LOO) analysis. Since MECO L2 contains 12 texts, we fit the LMMs on 11 texts and evaluate the learned relationships on the remaining unseen text in each fold.
blocks.zh: 前述分析显示,LLM超音速和阅读行为之间的分层关系因词汇熟练度和视差度而异. 一个重要的问题是,这些关系是否超越了用于LMM装配的文本。 为了解决这一问题,我们进行了 " 一劳永逸 " 分析。 由于MECO L2包含12个文本,所以我们把LMMs与11个文本相匹配,并评价每叠中剩下的未见文本的学习关系.

blocks.en: 5.1 Leave-One-Out Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 一次性休假评价

blocks.en:
For this LOO analysis, we focus on FPGD, our primary gaze measure, to evaluate whether the main finding on vocabulary proficiency transfers to unseen texts.
For each LOO fold, LMMs for High-Lex and Low-Lex readers are fitted and evaluated separately. The internal layer used for evaluation is selected exclusively from 11 training texts, based on the layer-wise Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL obtained from LMMs. Then, we evaluate the selected internal layer on the held-out text, and compare its predictive performance with that of the final LLM layer and a surface-feature baseline.
blocks.zh:
对于这一LOO分析,我们侧重于FPGD,即我们的主要视网膜测量,以评估关于词汇熟练度向无形文本转移的主要结论。
每套LOO折叠,高升读器和低升读器的LMM分别安装和评价. 用于评价的内部层完全选自11个训练文本,其基础是从LMMs获得的层次的QQ L\Delta LL. 然后,我们评估了被搁置文本上选定的内部层,并将其预测性能与最后LLM层和表层基线的预测性能进行比较。

blocks.en: This predictive analysis slightly differs from the main layer-profile analysis. In the main analysis, previous-word surprisal is included in the baseline LMM so that Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL isolates the unique contribution of current-word surprisal. In the LOO evaluation, surprisal of current and previous words from the selected layer is used jointly to predict log-FPGD, since the goal of this analysis is to evaluate how well the layer representations predict FPGD on an unseen text.
blocks.zh: 这种预测分析与主层剖面分析略有不同. 在主分析中,前名词的超额被列入基线LMM,这样QQ L \Delta LL就孤立了当前词的超额的独特贡献. 在LOO评价中,对选定层的当前和先前的单词进行补充,共同用于预测对数-FPGD,因为本分析的目的是评价层的表示方式如何在看不见的文本中预测FPGD。

blocks.en: In this LOO analysis, while LMM fitting on the 11 texts is performed on individual-level observations, evaluation on the held-out text is based on word-level averages within each proficiency group with fixed effects only. Therefore, the resulting scores reflect word-level variation at the group level rather than individual-level differences.
blocks.zh: 在这项最低可见度分析中,虽然在11个文本上配对的LMM是根据个人层面的观测结果进行的,但对被搁置文本的评估则根据每个熟练组内只有固定效果的字级平均值进行。 因此,所得的分数反映了组级的词级差异,而不是个人级的差异.

blocks.zh: 5.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate predictive performance on the held-out text in two ways. First, we calculate mean absolute error (MAE) between the observed and predicted log-FPGD for each word. Second, we compute Spearman correlations between residual word-level log-FPGD and current-word surprisal from the selected internal layer and the final layer.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Gaze Measure and Predictive Depth
blocks.zh: 6.1 盖兹测量和预测深度

blocks.en: One of the primary findings of this study is that Predictive Depth is generally deeper for TGD than for FPGD. This difference is highly consistent across LLMs, occurring in all tested LLMs for High-Lex and in most LLMs for Low-Lex. Since FPGD is restricted to first-pass reading while TGD also includes subsequent fixations, the two measures differ in both the timing and breadth of reading processes they capture. The deeper Predictive Depth observed for TGD suggests that surprisal from deeper layers becomes relatively more predictive as the gaze measure incorporates a broader span of processing.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要结论之一是,预测深度对于技术GD而言一般比FPGD更深。 这一差异在各种LLMs中非常一致,在所有测试的LLMs中出现在高脂层中,在大多数LLMs中发生在低脂层中。 由于FPGD仅限于先行读取,而TGD也包含后续定点,因此在它们所捕捉的读取过程的时间和广度上,这两种措施是不同的. 技术开发司观察到的更深的预测深度表明,由于视距测量包含更广泛的处理范围,从更深层得到的超额预测性相对较强。

blocks.en: One possible explanation is that this shift is related to the information encoded at different layer depths. Previous probing studies suggest that deeper LLM layers tend to encode more contextualized information ( Peters et al., 2018 ; Vulić et al., 2020 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . Therefore, TGD may be more sensitive than FPGD to surprisal representations that incorporate broader contextual information, as it includes processing that extends beyond the initial lexical access phase. This interpretation is consistent with the previous findings that relatively fast reading measures tend to be better predicted by shallower layers, whereas slower measures show stronger predictive power in deeper layers ( Kuribayashi et al., 2025 ; Tsipidi et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个可能的解释是,这种转变与不同层深处编码的信息有关. 以往的探测研究表明,更深的LLM层倾向于编码更贴近背景的信息(Peters等人,2018年;Vulić等人,2020年;Jin等人,2025年)。 因此,与FPGD相比,TGD对包含更广泛的背景信息的补充表述可能更为敏感,因为它包括超出初始词汇访问阶段的处理。 这种解释与之前的研究结果一致,即相对快速的读取量往往由较浅的地层预测得更好,而较慢的度量则显示更深的地层的预测力更强(Kuribayashi等人,2025年;Tsipidi等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Importantly, this pattern does not necessarily imply a direct mapping between layer depth and specific stages of human cognition. Rather, the consistent difference between FPGD and TGD suggests that layer depth may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,这种模式并不一定意味着在地层深度和人类认知的特定阶段之间进行直接测绘。 相反,FPGD与TGD之间的一贯差异表明,层深可能与不同视线测量所捕获的读取过程的时间和广度有关。

blocks.en: 6.2 Vocabulary Proficiency and Reading Processes
blocks.zh: 6.2 词汇能力和阅读过程

blocks.en: The difference between High-Lex and Low-Lex readers is more evident in FPGD, where Low-Lex readers tend to show deeper Predictive Depth than High-Lex readers. This difference becomes substantially weaker in TGD. Thus, vocabulary proficiency is more clearly reflected in first-pass reading than in the broader processing captured by TGD.
blocks.zh: 在FPGD中,高Lex和低Lex读取器的区别更为明显,低Lex读取器往往比高Lex读取器表现出更深的预测深度. 这一差异在技术合作司中大大缩小。 因此,词汇熟练程度在第一通道读取中比在TGD所捕获的更广泛的处理中更清楚地反映出来.

blocks.en: One possible interpretation is that readers with lower proficiency may rely on contextual information earlier when they encounter linguistic obstacles. Cognitive models of compensatory processing suggest that readers can recruit contextual information when faced with difficult vocabulary or syntax ( Stanovich, 1980 ) . Given that deeper layers tend to encode more contextualized information, the deeper Predictive Depth observed for Low-Lex readers in FPGD may be consistent with earlier reliance on such information during first-pass reading.
blocks.zh: 一种可能的解释是,熟练程度较低的读者在遇到语言障碍时,可能更早地依赖背景信息. 补偿性处理的认知模型表明,读者在面临词汇或语法困难时可以招聘背景信息(Stanovich,1980年). 鉴于更深层倾向于编码更贴近背景的信息,在FPGD中观测到的低层阅读器的更深的预测深度可能与早先在第一次通过阅读时对此类信息的依赖一致.

blocks.en: The smaller proficiency difference in TGD is also informative. Since TGD includes later and repeated fixations, it is likely to reflect a later stage of cognitive processing where contextual information has more opportunity to influence gaze behaviour in both proficiency groups. This would reduce the difference between High-Lex and Low-Lex readers in Predictive Depth, even if their first-pass reading patterns differ.
blocks.zh: 技术指导司的熟练程度差别较小,这也说明情况。 由于TGD包括后期和反复固定,它可能反映认知处理的后期阶段,在这个阶段,背景信息有更多的机会影响两个熟练组的凝视行为. 这可以减少预测深度的高-Lex和低-Lex读取器的区别,即使他们的首发读取模式不同.

blocks.en: 6.3 Interpreting Predictive Depth
blocks.zh: 6.3 解释预测深度

blocks.en: Predictive Depth should be interpreted as a summary of how the predictive power of surprisal is distributed across layers. A deeper Predictive Depth indicates that predictive power is weighted more towards deeper layers, but it does not imply greater reading difficulty or cognitive load. Likewise, our results do not assume a direct correspondence between LLM layers and specific stages of human cognition.
blocks.zh: 预测深度应被解释为对悬浮物的预测力如何分层分布的总结. 一个更深的预测深度表示预测力更向更深层加权,但这并不意味着阅读难度或认知负载更大. 同样,我们的结果也不假定LLM层与人类认知的特定阶段之间有直接的对应关系。

blocks.en: Instead, the observed findings suggest that layer depth may be informative about differences in the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by gaze measures. The consistently deeper Predictive Depth for TGD than for FPGD supports this interpretation. Furthermore, the differences in FPGD between two proficiency groups suggest that the layer-wise distribution can vary across reader profiles. Predictive Depth provides a descriptive way to compare these layer-wise patterns without assigning fixed cognitive interpretations to each layer.
blocks.zh: 相反,所观察到的研究结果表明,层层的深度可能有助于了解观察措施所捕捉到的阅读过程的时间和广度的差异。 技术GD的预测深度始终比FPGD更深,支持这一解释。 此外,两个熟练群体之间在FPGD方面的差异表明,各层次的分布可能因读者简介而异。 预测深度提供了一种描述性的方法,可以比较这些层次的图案,而不给每个层次分配固定的认知解释.

blocks.en: 6.4 Transfer Beyond Training Texts
blocks.zh: 6.4 转让超越培训文本

blocks.en: The leave-one-out analysis provides an external check on whether the layer-wise relationships identified in the main analysis extend beyond the texts used for fitting LMMs. Across LLMs, the selected internal layer generally performs better than the final layer on held-out texts, but the reduction in MAE is quite small in practice. The correlation analysis shows a similar pattern. Residual log-FPGD tends to correlate more strongly with surprisal from the selected internal layer than with that from the final layer, but the correlations remain weak to modest.
blocks.zh: " 一停 " 分析提供了一个外部检查,以确定主要分析中查明的层次关系是否超出用于装配LMM的文本。 在整个LLMs中,选定的内部层一般比搁置文本上的最后层表现更好,但在实践中,MAE的减少还很小。 相关分析显示类似模式. 残留的对数-FPGD往往与选定的内部层的溢价比与最后层的溢价更密切地相关,但相关程度仍然微弱到不大。

blocks.en: These results suggest that the advantage of internal layers is not limited to the texts on which the LMMs were fitted. At the same time, the small MAE improvements and modest correlations indicate that the transferable relationships are limited. The leave-one-out results provide out-of-sample support for the layer-wise analysis, but they do not imply that surprisal alone is sufficient for accurate prediction of gaze behaviour on unseen texts.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,内部层的优势不仅限于装配LMM的文本. 同时,小的MAE改进和小的关联性表明可转让关系有限. " 一放一出 " 的结果为分层分析提供了外部样本支持,但它们并不意味着,仅靠上层就足以准确预测在无形文本上的目光行为。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we investigate how the layer-wise relationship between surprisal from LLMs and human reading behaviour varies with vocabulary proficiency and gaze measure. With respect to RQ1 , vocabulary proficiency is associated with the layer-wise distribution of predictive power, especially for FPGD. Across LLMs, Low-Lex readers tend to show deeper Predictive Depth than High-Lex readers for FPGD, while this difference is substantially smaller for TGD.
Regarding RQ2 , the distribution differs systematically between FPGD and TGD. TGD itself generally shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both groups. These findings suggest that where predictive power is concentrated across LLM layers may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures, and that this relationship can vary with reader proficiency.
Our leave-one-out analysis further shows that the advantage of selected internal layers extends to unseen texts, but the overall improvement in prediction is limited.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们研究了从LLMs到人类阅读行为之间的分层关系如何因词汇熟练度和视线度而有所不同. 关于RQ1,词汇熟练度与预测力的分层分布有关,特别是对FPGD而言. 在整个LLMs中,Low-Lex读取器往往比FPGD的High-Lex读取器显示更深的预测深度,而TGD的这种差异则要小得多.
关于RQ2,FPGD和TGD之间的分布有系统差异。 TGD本身在这两个组中一般都显示出比FPGD更深的预测深度. 这些研究结果表明,在预测力集中在LLM层的地方,可能与不同视线测量所捕获的读取过程的时机和广度有关,而这种关系会随着读者的熟练程度而变化.
我们的 " 一放一出 " 分析进一步表明,某些内部层的优势延伸到无形文本,但预测的总体改进有限。

blocks.en: Future work should examine whether these findings generalize to other languages, datasets, and additional measures of reader proficiency. It will also be important to move beyond group-level comparisons and investigate whether individual reader characteristics can be incorporated directly into models of layer-wise surprisal and gaze behaviour.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应审查这些结论是否普遍适用于其他语文、数据集和读者熟练程度的额外衡量标准。 还必须超越群体层面的比较,并调查是否可以将个别读者特征直接纳入层层优势和凝视行为模式。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
While this study utilizes LexTALE for grouping readers, reading ability is composed of multiple aspects, and vocabulary knowledge is merely one component.
Factors such as background knowledge and working memory capacity also play critical roles in the reading process. In addition, the analysis based on LexTALE groups does not capture continuous variation among readers. Future work could incorporate multiple proficiency measures at the individual level rather than discrete reader groups.
blocks.zh:
虽然本研究利用LexTALE将读者分组,但阅读能力由多个方面组成,词汇知识只是一个组成部分.
背景知识和工作记忆能力等因素在阅读过程中也发挥着关键作用. 此外,基于LexTALE组的分析没有捕捉到读者之间的持续差异. 今后的工作可以包括个人一级的多种能力措施,而不是单独的读者群体。

blocks.en: Also, our experiments are based on English reading data from the MECO L2 dataset. The layer-wise relationships observed in this study may be influenced by the specific properties of the English language, particular texts in the corpus, or reader population in the dataset. Languages with different morphological and syntactic properties may show different patterns of layer-wise predictive power. Evaluating the same analysis across languages and datasets will be important for establishing the generalizability of the findings.
blocks.zh: 另外,我们的实验是基于从MECO L2数据集读取的英语数据. 本研究观察到的层层关系可能受英语具体属性的影响,特别是本体的文本,或数据集的读者群. 具有不同形态和综合特性的语言可能显示不同图层的预测力模式. 评价不同语文和数据集的相同分析,对于确定调查结果的普遍性十分重要。

blocks.en: The linear mixed-effects models used in this study include random effects to account for repeated observations. However, richer random-effects structures, such as random slopes or word-level predictors, may capture variation that is not represented in our study.
blocks.zh: 本研究采用的线性混合效应模型包括随机效应,以计入重复观测. 然而,更丰富的随机效应结构,如随机坡度或词级预测器,可能捕捉到我们研究中没有体现的变异.

blocks.en: Predictive Depth is a summary statistic calculated from the distribution of Δ ​ L ​ L \Delta LL across layers. While layer depth is normalized within each LLM, equivalent normalized depth may not represent equivalent information across model architectures. Therefore, comparisons of Predictive Depth across LLMs should be interpreted as comparisons of layer-wise patterns rather than as evidence that particular depths have the same functional role across LLMs.
blocks.zh: 预测深度(Presidentive Depth)是计算出QQ L\Delta LL跨层分布的汇总统计. 虽然每个LLM内部的层深度都实现了正常化,但等效的正常化深度可能并不代表模型架构之间的等效信息. 因此,对法学硕士的预测深度的比较应解释为对分层模式的比较,而不是证明特定深度对法学硕士的功能作用相同。

blocks.en: B.1 Surprisal Extraction
blocks.zh: B.1 超额开采

blocks.en: We use HuggingFace Transformers library to extract the log-probabilities for calculating surprisal values. All inputs are processed as plain text without additional prompt templates. While the interest areas of eye-tracking measurements often include adjacent punctuation marks, such as periods or quotation marks, we exclude these symbols from our surprisal analysis to focus on linguistic and cognitive processing of lexical items. In other words, for words followed by punctuation, its surprisal is calculated based solely on the constituent characters of the word itself.
blocks.zh: 我们使用HuggingFace变形器库来提取计算超额值的日志概率. 所有输入都作为纯文本处理,没有额外的快速模板. 虽然眼跟踪测量的兴趣领域往往包括相邻的点痕,如时段或引号,但我们将这些符号排除在我们的辅助分析之外,以专注于词汇项目的语言和认知处理. 换句话说,对于后面的语句,它的辅词完全根据词本身的组成字符计算.

blocks.en: B.2 LMM Settings
blocks.zh: B.2 LMM 设置

blocks.en: To fit the linear mixed-effects models, we use the default optimizer lbfgs (Limited-memory BFGS) in the statsmodels library in Python. The maximum number of iterations is set to 1000. Other hyperparameters are set to default values.
blocks.zh: 为了配合线性混合效应模型,我们在Python的Statsmodels库中使用默认优化器 lbfgs(Limited-memory BFGS). 重迭的最大次数设定为1000次. 其他超参数设定为默认值.
